text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Cadet cohort (MicroCert) migrating to Dedicated next week. We need three evening enablement sessions to cover APAC/EMEA overlap + one targeted 1:1 for a renewal-risk account (KestrelMed). Proposed session dates: 2024-11-14, 2024-11-16, 2024-11-18 at 21:00 UTC. Can folks confirm availability + what you'll cover? Also need a short post-session feedback flow.

jon_eng: I can lead two sessions (11/14, 11/16). I'll cover migration checklist, model pinning, KV cache warmup, and quick quantization notes. Do we want a pre-seeded dev workspace for attendees?

tess_enable: I can take 11/18. I'll prepare a hands-on lab and two short failure-cases for troubleshooting practice. Agree on seeded environments — reduces flakiness.

raj_sre: I'll be available as infra standby for the first 30 minutes each night to answer node/KV questions. If you expect heavy KV batches, tell me 24h ahead so I can pre-warm.

oliver_pm: Proposed session structure (60m): 5m intro + goals, 20m demo (migration + pitfalls), 25m guided lab, 10m Q&A + feedback. I'll own the short CSAT + one quick NPS-like question. Also volunteer to run the single KestrelMed 1:1 if preferred.

maria_cs: Thanks — I'll run the poll for time preference (21:00 UTC vs 00:00 UTC) to capture APAC folks who might prefer later. Please use reactions only. I'll lock slots after poll closes. :calendar:

reminder-bot: Poll created: https://redwood.tools/polls/1725432100 - options: 21:00 UTC, 00:00 UTC. Poll closes in 18 hours.

jon_eng: Voted 21:00. Also dropped two provisional calendar invites to the Cadet cohort calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/c/microcert-cadet — please don't finalize until poll closes.

maria_cs: Draft agenda + runbook link below.

```
Agenda (60m)
- 00:00-00:05: Welcome + goals (maria_cs)
- 00:05-00:25: Migration demo: pinning, KV cache warmup, quantization tradeoffs (jon_eng)
- 00:25-00:50: Hands-on lab: guided migration tasks in pre-seeded dev env (tess_enable)
- 00:50-01:00: Q&A, next steps, share feedback form (oliver_pm)
Post-session: publish cohort notes, attach logs and config snippets, surface any activation blockers into CS-1289.
```

ajira: Created ticket CS-1289 to track KestrelMed renewal-risk + 1:1 actions (assignee: maria_cs).

tess_enable: I'll produce two prompt-sets and a fail-case checklist for the lab. Will link them in CS-1289 before EOD.

raj_sre: Reminder — if the lab will run sample KV-heavy queries, send the keyspace + expected QPS. I can pre-warm and pin pods to avoid cold-starts.

maria_cs: Perfect. Locking trainers: jon_eng (11/14, 11/16), tess_enable (11/18), raj_sre standby, oliver_pm runs feedback capture. I'll send calendar invites after poll closes and add KestrelMed 1:1 slot. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
